tasks.short: Sing or dance in the piece.

steps.what: List the number already set in this performance.
Sing or dance during dramatic or comedic performances.
Hold the number through to the end of the performance.

tasks.design: A number already set in the performance is listed from {CALENDAR}. The actor sings or dances during the dramatic or comedic performance. A number with no id is not listed. The list does not sing or dance.
tasks.previous_blocker: The number was confirmed in a whisper at the side of the stage.
tasks.enabler_now: A number already set can be listed before the actor goes on.
tasks.human_edge: The actor can know the number and still have to perform it.
tasks.altitude: A set number can be listed. The actor still sings or dances.

reach.task: Know which number is set, and still perform it.
reach.learn: The number can be listed. The performance stays here.

evidence.claim: A number already set in the performance can be listed. The list cannot sing or dance.
The actor performs the number. A listing is not a performance.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An actor in a mid-size European company or company of players. A call sheet does not audition, rehearse, or perform. A list does not rank who is seen.
Fields: Number id, produced by the order already set. A number with no id is not listed. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the actor finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the order the company already keeps. The actor performs.
unknowns: Which numbers are cut on the night.
research_questions: What share of numbers are set before the performance?
Which numbers are added in rehearsal?

already_counted.description: The actor still sings or dances.
The actor still holds the number to the end.

incremental.description: The actor confirms a number the order did not hold.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is listing a number already set in the performance. It disappears when the number is missing and the actor confirms it. Singing and dancing stay with the actor.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: List the stunt already named for this production.
Prepare and perform action stunts for picture, television, or stage.
Stop the stunt when the stage or the set is not ready.

tasks.design: A stunt already named for the motion picture, television, or stage production is listed from {CALENDAR}. The actor prepares and performs it, and stops it when the set is not ready. A stunt with no id is not listed. The list does not perform the stunt.
tasks.previous_blocker: The stunt was described verbally on the set, and the actor had to ask which take it belonged to.
tasks.enabler_now: A named stunt can be listed before the actor prepares it.
tasks.still_hard: The stunt, and the decision to stop it, which stay with the actor.
tasks.human_edge: The actor can refuse a named stunt when the set is not the one rehearsed.
tasks.altitude: A named stunt can be listed. The actor still prepares and performs it, and still stops it when the set is not ready.

reach.task: Have the stunt named on the call, and leave the performance and the stop with the actor.
reach.learn: The name can be listed. The stunt stays here.

evidence.claim: A stunt already named for a production can be listed. The list cannot prepare or perform it.
The actor performs the stunt and can stop it. A name on a call is not a clearance to do it on an unready set.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An actor in a mid-size European company or company of players. A call sheet does not audition, rehearse, or perform. A list does not rank who is seen.
Fields: Stunt id, produced by the call already made. A stunt with no id is not listed. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the actor finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the call the company already keeps. The actor decides whether the set is ready.
unknowns: Which stops are the actor's and which are a safety lead's.
research_questions: What share of stunts are named before the day?
Which named stunts are stopped on set?

already_counted.description: The actor still prepares and performs the stunt.
The actor still stops it when the set is not ready.

incremental.description: The actor confirms a stunt the call did not hold.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is listing a stunt already named for the production. It disappears when the stunt is unnamed and the actor confirms it. Preparing, performing, and stopping the stunt stay with the actor.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: List the running order already set for the event.
Introduce performances and performers to stimulate excitement.
Coordinate a smooth transition of acts during events.

tasks.design: A running order already set for the event is listed from {CALENDAR}. The actor introduces the performances and the performers and coordinates the transition. An act with no order id is not listed. The list does not introduce anyone.
tasks.previous_blocker: The next act was pointed out from the wing as the introduction started.
tasks.enabler_now: A running order already set can be listed before the actor introduces the act.
tasks.still_hard: The introduction, and a transition when an act is late.
tasks.human_edge: The actor can cover a late act in a way the order cannot script.
tasks.altitude: A set running order can be listed. The actor still introduces the acts and still coordinates the transition.

reach.task: Have the order of the event, and leave the introduction with the actor.
reach.learn: The order can be listed. The introduction stays here.

evidence.claim: A running order already set can be listed. The list cannot introduce a performer or coordinate a transition.
The actor speaks the introduction. An order is not an introduction.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An actor in a mid-size European company or company of players. A call sheet does not audition, rehearse, or perform. A list does not rank who is seen.
Fields: Event id and act id, produced by the running order already set. An act with no id is not listed. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the actor finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the order the company already keeps. The actor introduces.
unknowns: Which events already have a running order.
research_questions: What share of introductions start from a set order?
Which acts arrive out of that order?

already_counted.description: The actor still introduces the performers.
The actor still coordinates the transition.

incremental.description: The actor confirms an act the order did not hold.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is listing a running order already set for the event. It disappears when the act is missing and the actor confirms it. Introducing the performers and coordinating the transition stay with the actor.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: List the clown costume and makeup already assigned.
Dress in comical clown costumes and makeup and perform.
Perform comedy routines to entertain audiences.

tasks.design: A clown costume and makeup already assigned are listed from {CALENDAR}. The actor dresses and performs the comedy routine for the audience. A costume with no id is not listed. The list does not perform the routine.
tasks.previous_blocker: The assigned costume was in a different dressing room from the one the actor was sent to.
tasks.enabler_now: An assigned costume can be listed before the actor dresses.
tasks.human_edge: The actor can wear the assigned costume and still have to play the room.
tasks.altitude: An assigned costume can be listed. The actor still dresses and still performs the comedy routine.

reach.task: Have the costume assigned, and leave the dressing and the routine with the actor.
reach.learn: The costume can be listed. The performance stays here.

evidence.claim: A clown costume and makeup already assigned can be listed. The list cannot dress the actor or perform the routine.
The actor dresses and performs. An assignment is not a performance.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An actor in a mid-size European company or company of players. A call sheet does not audition, rehearse, or perform. A list does not rank who is seen.
Fields: Costume id, produced by the assignment already made. A costume with no id is not listed. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the actor finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the assignment the company already keeps. The actor performs.
research_questions: What share of clown appearances have a costume assigned?
Which routines change with the audience?

already_counted.description: The actor still dresses and starts the performance.
The actor still performs the comedy routine.

incremental.description: The actor confirms a costume the assignment did not hold.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is listing a clown costume and makeup already assigned. It disappears when the costume is unassigned and the actor confirms it. Dressing and performing the routine stay with the actor.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The actor still sings, dances, performs the stunt, introduces the act, and plays the clown. A number, a named stunt, or a costume already assigned can be listed. The body of the work stays with the actor.
reach: Musicians and singers perform the number themselves, and this job learns a listed spot is not the song.
Merchandise displayers can have a costume assigned, and this job learns the actor still dresses and performs.
skills_to_grow: Perform the stunt. A named stunt on a call is not the stunt.
Sing, dance, introduce, and play the clown in person.
role.ambitious_version: Assigned numbers, named stunts, and assigned costumes are listed first. The singing, the stunt, the introduction, and the clown stay with the actor.
